googleAuthOnly.title: Exclusive Google Authentication
googleAuthOnly.label: Enforce Google Login Only
googleAuthOnly.description: Disable password login and public email registration completely. All users must authenticate via Google Workspace / OAuth.
googleAuthOnly.activeNotice: Google Auth Only is currently active. Conventional email/password logins and related password complexity policies are disabled on the frontend.

standard.title: Standard Authentication & Registration
standard.desc: Configure conventional registration and login methods for visitors.

is_registration_enabled.label: User Registration
is_registration_enabled.description: Allow visitors to register for a new account.

is_email_verification_required.label: Email Verification Required
is_email_verification_required.description: Require users to verify their email address before accessing protected features.

is_google_auth_enabled.label: Enable Google Login
is_google_auth_enabled.description: Show Google OAuth button alongside the standard login form.

is_2fa_enabled.label: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
is_2fa_enabled.description: Allow users to enable TOTP 2FA authenticator app on their profile.

security.title: Password & Security Policies
security.desc: Set password complexity and brute-force protection thresholds.

password_min_length.label: Minimum Password Length
password_min_length.description: Minimum number of characters required for user passwords.

session_lifetime_days.label: Session Lifetime (Days)
session_lifetime_days.description: Number of days a user session cookie remains valid.

max_login_attempts.label: Max Login Attempts
max_login_attempts.description: Number of failed password attempts before locking the account.

lockout_duration_minutes.label: Lockout Duration (Minutes)
lockout_duration_minutes.description: Duration in minutes an account remains locked after exceeding failed attempts.
